CLEAN_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.data_volume: Exactly 14,200 deterministic synthetic primary metadata records across tenants/cases, operating systems, endpoint capabilities, live/offline sources, artifact families, outcomes, custody transfers, holds, and export references. multi-tenant case authorization before data access

durable queueing, attempt fencing, bounded retries, idempotent inbox, and restart reconciliation

CLEAN_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.state_model: PostgreSQL is authoritative for case, inventory generation, policy revision, plans, attempts, leases, inbox, evidence metadata, custody, audit, and export jobs. Queue claims and leases are fenced by worker, attempt, token, and deadline; retries are distinct from terminal source disposition. Events bind case, endpoint, collection item, active attempt, source authority, and payload digest. Synthetic opaque evidence metadata binds digest, length, case, endpoint, source, plan, item, attempt, capture time, and validation traits. Custody is append-only. Coverage derives from every requested source disposition. Export is an authorized staged job with deterministic ordered manifest, digest verification, atomic publication, and immutable identity. Restart reconciles expired leases, accepted attempts, inbox, and lab effects before redispatch.
